# AST Nodes
class Node:
    pass

class Literal(Node):
    __slots__ = ('char',)
    def __init__(self, char):
        self.char = char

class Dot(Node):
    __slots__ = ()

class CharClass(Node):
    __slots__ = ('chars', 'negated')
    def __init__(self, chars, negated):
        self.chars = chars  # frozenset of chars
        self.negated = negated

class Group(Node):
    __slots__ = ('capture', 'body')
    def __init__(self, capture, body):
        self.capture = capture  # int or None
        self.body = body  # Node (the sub-pattern)

class Alt(Node):
    __slots__ = ('branches',)
    def __init__(self, branches):
        self.branches = branches  # list of Nodes

class Quantifier(Node):
    __slots__ = ('atom', 'lo', 'hi', 'lazy')
    def __init__(self, atom, lo, hi, lazy):
        self.atom = atom
        self.lo = lo
        self.hi = hi  # None for unbounded
        self.lazy = lazy

class AnchorStart(Node):
    __slots__ = ()

class AnchorEnd(Node):
    __slots__ = ()

class Seq(Node):
    __slots__ = ('children',)
    def __init__(self, children):
        self.children = children  # list of Nodes
